name: Artifact Search (deterministic catalog + typed-record memory substrate + hybrid lexical retrieval)
purpose: The Collective Agent's authoritative catalog + memory-record substrate (D-0080 Wave 1/2, arch position 23), built to the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT (D-0083). A stdlib-only Python worker (artifact_search.py) owns a SQLite database (sources / documents / document_versions / chunks + records / record_edges + vectors + FTS5) with full provenance. 0.2 adopts the MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 record+provenance ENVELOPE, adds the generic 'ingest_records' SINK so Wave-2 producers (repo.intel #38, episode.memory #39) can land TYPED records (symbol/relationship/episode/failure/summary/...) not chunks, and forward-migrates a shipped-0.1 db in place. Ops: 'ingest' walks a root, content-hashes an inventory, detects new/changed/moved/deleted, chunks Markdown structurally (headings/sections/code-fence-aware) with a generic-text fallback, indexes chunk text in SQLite FTS5, mock-embeds new/changed chunks as float32 LE BLOB vectors keyed on embedding_space_id (the D-0077 seam; the real adapter #35 drops in at fold), reconciles with NO duplicate chunks, serves an EXPLICIT stale fallback when a changed source fails to parse, tombstones deletions, runs a DB integrity check, and emits a deterministic catalog_digest (extended to cover records + edges). 'ingest-records' is the s1 typed-record SINK: deterministic + idempotent, validates ids/required fields, rejects malformed records with a surfaced reason, materializes first-class parent/child edges. 'search' (retriever 0.2 + A4, #37/#40 consume) returns ranked, provenance-complete hits across chunks AND records in DETERMINISTIC order (stable tie_break_key): span object {start,end} + span_label, record_id/record_version_id/record_kind, currentness/status + authority_level, and PER-CHANNEL diagnostics (lexical/vector/fused rank+score, fusion_algo/version, embedding_space_id, index_snapshot, filter_decisions); the opaque single 'score' is RETIRED. 0.3 realizes MEMORY_CONTRACT Amendment A4 (D-0092, Tier-0 seams, ADDITIVE + backward-compatible): filters.namespace is a HARD retrieval boundary (a single value OR an explicit set) enforced BEFORE ranking with an all-hits-match assertion (a cross-namespace hit is a fail-closed 'namespace_leak', never a low-ranked hit); a current_only retrieval MODE (filters.mode=current_only, top-level mode=current_only, or the exclude_stale/current_only aliases) HARD-EXCLUDES any non-'current' record; the CLOSED record_kind enum RESERVES 'node' (the navigation/hierarchy seam) + 'working' (a per-task_id working-memory record, content_role!=evidence, EXCLUDED from ordinary retrieval unless the request scopes to its task_id) and the edge set RESERVES member_of_node/child_of_node/contradicts -- all admitted ADDITIVELY via a schema_version 2->3 in-place migration (a records.task_id/content_role column) that rewrites NONE of the sources/documents/document_versions/chunks tables (NO tree/store/detection built at Tier 0). 'list-records' exposes the s1 record ENVELOPE (source_chunk via a view/adapter + typed records; working records task-scoped). 'migrate' forward-migrates a 0.1/0.2 db to schema_version 3 in place (1->2->3, version-chained, idempotent). 'embed' returns the mock embedding envelope; 'integrity' runs PRAGMA integrity_check + catalog invariants; 'catalog' returns catalog_digest + counts; 'export-chunk-texts' / 'store-embeddings' / 'get-vector' are the fold drop-in (export ordered chunk texts -> real adapter -> store float32 BLOB vectors by chunk_id -> round-trip). Determinism: chunk/document/version ids are content+path derived; the s1 chunk_occurrence_id derives ONLY from immutable inputs (document_version_id + chunker_fingerprint + span + chunk_content_hash), never insertion order; identical corpus+records content yields an identical catalog_digest across runs AND machines; the SQLite file itself is NOT byte-reproducible. CPU-only, no model, no network, NO vector index/ANN and NO real embeddings this wave -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance. Non-goals (NOT built): a vector index/ANN/vector search, real embeddings (#35), #38 parsers / #39 schemas, model summaries, context compiler, UI, web search; and (A4 Tier-0) the bounded-fanout tree / node-synopsis generation / shortlist-and-descend, the working-memory STORE lifecycle, contradiction DETECTION, and the query-classification stage (#37/#40) -- the kinds/edges/seams are RESERVED here, not built. 0.4 realizes MEMORY_CONTRACT Amendment A5 (D-0096, i33 Tier-0 NAMESPACE-CLOSURE + SUPERSESSION-HARDENING; ADDITIVE + backward-compatible): #36 is the retriever/catalog ENFORCEMENT POINT. (U1') namespace is an end-to-end information-flow boundary -- ONE canonical predicate ns_permitted(candidate_ns, effective_allowed) (the A5 mirror of #37's canonical, byte-identical accept/reject) is enforced at EVERY retrieval stage AND every graph hop (the superseded_by chain walk; the list-records edge walk), and EVERY returned/reachable object is scope-checked; a cross-namespace candidate is EXCLUDED before ranking and leaves NO identifying metadata -- only a namespace_violation_count surfaces while identifying detail goes to a PRIVILEGED local security_log (a DB table + an append-only file, NEVER returned); a returned hit outside the effective set is a fail-closed 'namespace_leak' ABORT; a persisted DERIVED/aggregate/node record whose provenance spans >1 namespace is REJECTED at ingest ('cross_namespace_derivation'); effective_allowed is CALLER-SUPPLIED (absent = unscoped back-compat; an explicit EMPTY set = zero hits; NO implicit all/wildcard/prefix/parent). (U4') candidate-INDEPENDENT supersession: a NEW s5 'superseded' status + first-class 'superseded_by'/'supersedes' edges; effective_current(record) is computed from the CATALOG/graph (status==current AND no reachable live in-scope successor at the snapshot), so current_only EXCLUDES a predecessor EVEN WHEN its successor is absent from the returned pool; chain invariants hold (acyclic; canonical direction; NO cross-namespace supersession; a branch of >=2 live successors is FLAGGED conflicted, never a silent pick). (U2') retriever hit provenance fields are CONDITIONAL on provenance_mode (direct_span | derived_record | aggregate | tombstone) and RESERVE candidate_role (navigation|evidence) + retrieval-stage lineage (retrieval_stage_id/parent_stage_id/retrieval_plan_id). (U3') the 'working' kind reserves the working-STORE fields (working_state_id/state_version/parent_state_version/namespace_scope/grant_snapshot_ref/created_from_packet_id/lifecycle_state/writer_authority; NO store lifecycle built) and ordinary 'search' REJECTS record_kind=working by default -- retrievable ONLY by a CONJUNCTIVE op (exact task_id AND an in-scope namespace authorization). All admitted via a schema_version 3->4 in-place migration (records gains the provenance_mode + working-store columns; a new privileged security_log table) that rewrites NONE of the sources/documents/document_versions/chunks tables. Non-goals unchanged (no tree/node-synopsis/shortlist-and-descend, no working-STORE lifecycle/promotion, no contradiction DETECTION, no query classifier -- those are #37/#40 or a later tier). 0.5 realizes MEMORY_CONTRACT Amendment A6 (D-0098, i34 Tier-1 BOUNDED-FANOUT HIERARCHY; ADDITIVE + backward-compatible; schema_version 4->5): #36 turns the A4/A5 RESERVED node seam into a real DETERMINISTIC build (NO model). (H1) a `node` is a derived record (provenance_mode=derived_record, content_role/candidate_role=navigation, namespace-homogeneous, one parent, acyclic) with a deterministic structural synopsis (child_count/subtree_record_count/bounded entity_union/bounded lexical_descriptor/time_range/authority_set/kind_histogram + a no-false-negative Bloom presence_filter) and a SUFFICIENT-STATISTICS vector aggregate (vector_sum+count+missing+embedding_space_id, quantized-before-hash -> topology-independent + byte-reproducible; ABSENT while the vector channel is empty); child_of_node/member_of_node CANONICAL edges live in record_edges (the stored child_ids/member_ids are a rebuildable PROJECTION whose digest == the edges). (H4) a DETERMINISTIC BALANCED bulk-builder even-partitions a total leaf order (coarse_group_key, content_hash, leaf_id) into pages <= MAX_FANOUT (default 16) so balance is INDEPENDENT of the grouping key (a low-cardinality/dominant key never yields deep thin chains); live incremental split is DEFERRED (i35) -- a membership/grouping change sets topology_state=rebuild_required + serves the flat path. (H3) hierarchy IDENTITY (hierarchy_id stable per (namespace, kind); tree_version per build) + ATOMIC publication (in-memory shadow-build committed in ONE transaction; one current version; a compile pins one tree_version). (H2) THREE separated state axes -- evidence status (s5) / topology_state {valid|rebuild_required|corrupt} / navigation-synopsis freshness {fresh|stale} via MONOTONIC generations + CAS-cleared regen (closes the ABA/lost-update stale-clear race); deterministic staleness propagation up the ancestor path; summary_stale ROUTES but never ANSWERS (a node never enters evidence[]). (H5 SAFETY-CRITICAL) write-time + transitive namespace HOMOGENEITY over every aggregate + nav-visible object; separate roots for a multi-namespace compile (never a merged root). (H6 SAFETY-CRITICAL) authorization-bound frontier ops shortlist(query, effective_allowed_namespaces, hierarchy_version, corpus_snapshot, k) -> ranked navigation roots and descend(node_id, retrieval_plan_id, effective_allowed_namespaces, hierarchy_version, corpus_snapshot) -> a node's children/leaf-members, ns_permitted at EVERY hop + on every returned object; an arbitrary/foreign/out-of-scope node_id FAILS CLOSED with count-only (no identifying metadata). The load-bearing SAFE-PRUNING invariant (frontier red-team pack b4c90545): a navigation-derived value may POSITIVELY prioritize a branch but MUST NOT NEGATIVELY exclude one unless a deterministic channel-specific NO-FALSE-NEGATIVE predicate proves the subtree cannot satisfy the requirement -- exact id/path/lexical/entity via a Bloom absence proof, kind/authority via an exact set, time via an exact range; a bounded descriptor NEVER prunes, a centroid NEVER prunes, a STALE synopsis NEVER prunes. schema_version 4->5 is additive in-place (NEW `nodes` + `hierarchies` tables + node-edge rows in record_edges; sources/documents/document_versions/chunks/records byte-identical; node edges EXCLUDED from catalog_digest so the corpus fingerprint stays stable and zero nodes == today's flat retrieval byte-for-byte; a per-tree tree_digest covers the hierarchy). New ops: build-hierarchy (deterministic (re)build; one per namespace of kind source_module), shortlist, descend, hierarchy (status), refresh-hierarchy (lazy stale regen), hierarchy-mark-changed / hierarchy-regen (the propagation + CAS regen entry points), prune-verdict (the safe-pruning oracle). Still no model / real embeddings / working-STORE lifecycle / query ROUTER / compiler shortlist-and-descend PLAN (#37/#40 or i35). 0.6 (i36, D-0100 fold reconciliation; ADDITIVE, READ-ONLY, NO migration -- schema_version STAYS 5) adds the clean by-record_version_id 'get-record' body-fetch op that #40's leaf HYDRATION needs (i35 Lane A recorded that #40 read #36's `records` table directly because #36 had NO by-rvid op). get-record takes rvid(s) -- a single target_id/record_version_id OR an rvids[]/record_version_ids[] array -- plus the CALLER-SUPPLIED CLOSED effective_allowed_namespaces set, and returns per rvid the FULL s1 ENVELOPE (the shipped _source_chunk_envelope / _record_envelope) PLUS an evidence body sufficient for hydration (the shipped _chunk_hit_base / _record_hit_base provenance derivation + the full `text` -- text/content, source_span{start,end}, content_hash, chunk_content_hash, source_path/abs_path, namespace, authority_level, status/currentness, valid_from/valid_to, section_path/heading, provenance_mode, embedding_space_id), REUSING the shipped provenance derivation (no second path; provenance holds -- content_hash == the source sha256 and the span reproduces the source bytes). An rvid is EITHER a typed-record record_version_id (the `records` table) OR a source_chunk chunk_occurrence_id (the v_records_source_chunk view) -- the SAME id space `search` hits + `descend` leaf_members refer to. A5-CLOSED (identical DECISIONS to `search`): (U1') ns_permitted on EVERY returned record; a foreign/out-of-scope rvid FAILS CLOSED count-only (a namespace_violation_count; identifying detail ONLY to the privileged security_log, NEVER to the caller) and a record reaching records[] outside the effective set is a fail-closed 'namespace_leak' ABORT; (U3') a record_kind=working record is returned ONLY under CONJUNCTIVE access (an in-scope namespace authorization AND an exact task_id match) else a count-only working_denied_count; (U4') VERSION-EXACT by default (the rvid exactly as stored) with the catalog-computed supersession flags (effective_current / superseded_by / supersession_conflicted) surfaced, and an optional current_only mode that excludes a predecessor whose in-scope LIVE successor exists (pool-independent) as current_excluded_count. Deterministic + envelope-only (records[] sorted by record_version_id; NO timestamps in the result; unresolved rvids surface count-only as unresolved_count); an explicit EMPTY effective set = zero results, absent = unscoped back-compat. NO corpus writes, NO new table, NO migration. #40 ADOPTS get-record in i37 (this wave only SHIPS the op). 0.7 (i39, D-0107 follow-on; the FAST-BEAM RECALL LEVER; ADDITIVE, RANKING-ONLY, NO migration -- schema_version STAYS 5, catalog_digest + tree_digest UNCHANGED) strengthens shortlist/descend so the hierarchy fast-path itself contributes recall (i36 measured the bounded-beam descend LOSSY -- the exhaustive #36-flat fallback carried recall). It is RANKING ONLY and NEVER a pruning oracle: the safe-pruning no-false-negative predicates (prune_verdict / SOUND channels) are UNCHANGED; a bounded descriptor may only REORDER candidates, never negatively EXCLUDE a branch; a stale synopsis never prunes; end-to-end (packet + guaranteed) recall NEVER drops. shortlist CACHES this compile's query terms (the #40 port holds ONE Catalog across its single shortlist -> many descend calls; the CLI opens a fresh Catalog per op, so there is NO cross-query bleed and a descend with no prior shortlist is BYTE-IDENTICAL to 0.6.0); descend then RANKS its child NODES by an integer, positive-only structural-synopsis match against those terms (a term in the bounded lexical_descriptor [df] dominates; else a term MAYBE-present in the no-false-negative presence_filter [Bloom] is a weak positive; entity_union + kind_histogram matches add) -- emitting an ADDITIVE integer children[].match_score + the reorder so #40's FROZEN frontier slice keeps the branch that leads to the required leaf -- AND RANKS the node's leaf_members by lexical overlap with the query (load-bearing because #40's port hydrates each leaf's lexical_score FROM ITS POSITION in leaf_members, seeding selpol + the packet budget: a decisive leaf buried in src_ref order was dropped by the budget even after descend reached it). Nav cost stays bounded O(beam_b*depth_d) (beam WIDTH is #40-owned + out of scope). Port response SHAPES are byte-stable (only ORDER changes + the additive integer match_score), so a flat/non-descend/unscoped #40 compile stays byte-identical (the #40 i35 public-port gate 32/32 + i34 smoke 38/38 hold) and the #37 rehearsal FLAT metrics are byte-identical; the WIRED rehearsal's hierarchy_path_recall RISES (measured: all labeled descend-class queries' fast-path reach 1/3 -> 3/3; rare-term scale recall ~2x) while guaranteed + packet recall stay 1,000,000 ppm -- so #37's committed test_rehearsal_eval.py::test_wired() needs a one-line WIRED_STRUCTURAL_DIGEST re-pin (an orchestrator/#37 follow-on; the residual scale gap is upper-level Bloom saturation over a shared vocabulary -- a bounded-synopsis limit whose remaining lever is #40's beam width).

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op ingest|ingest-records|list-records|migrate|search|embed|integrity|catalog|export-chunk-texts|get-record|store-embeddings|get-vector|build-hierarchy|shortlist|descend|hierarchy|refresh-hierarchy|hierarchy-mark-changed|hierarchy-regen|prune-verdict (default search); -Query <string> (search/shortlist); -Text <string> (embed single); -Source <label>; -Root <dir> (ingest); -DbPath <path> (default runtime/catalog/artifact_search.db); -Mode fts|exact (default fts); -K <int, default 10>; -Dim <int, default 64>; -Normalize:$true|$false (default true); -MaxFiles <int budget>; -MaxChunkChars <int, default 4000>; -EmbedProvider mock|none; -Limit <int>; -TargetKind chunk|record; -TargetId <id> (get-vector single target; get-record single record_version_id); -PythonPath <python>; -WorkerPath <artifact_search.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json {op, query, text, texts[], source, root, db, mode, k, dim, normalize, max_files, max_chunk_chars, embed_provider, include[], exclude[], exclude_dirs[], filters{source,namespace,type,path_prefix,content_hash,record_kind,status,exclude_stale,task_id,mode}, records[<s1 envelope record>], ingest_run{producer,producer_version,namespace,repo_commit,worktree_dirty}, limit, chunk_ids[], vectors[][], provider_id, embedding_space_id, model_id, model_version, model_sha256, engine_build, target_kind, target_id, rvids[], record_version_ids[], record_version_id, task_id, current_only, python_path, namespace, max_fanout, node_id, hierarchy_version, corpus_snapshot, effective_allowed_namespaces[], retrieval_plan_id, include_nodes, channel, key, leaf_id, expected_generation}>' (named params override matching keys). ingest-records/migrate/build-hierarchy create-or-open the db (no pre-existing db required); other db-ops (incl. get-record) require an existing db. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: ingest|ingest-records|list-records|migrate|search|embed|integrity|catalog|export-chunk-texts|get-record (A5-closed by-rvid body-fetch, i36/D-0100)|store-embeddings|get-vector|build-hierarchy|shortlist|descend|hierarchy|refresh-hierarchy|hierarchy-mark-changed|hierarchy-regen|prune-verdict (A6/D-0098 hierarchy ops).

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: search: the query text (fts tokens AND-ed; exact = literal substring over chunk/record text + filename).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: embed: a single text (alternative to texts[]).

inputs.name: texts
inputs.description: embed: a batch of texts; vectors align 1:1 in EXACT input order.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: ingest: a stable source label (slugged to source_id; the logical corpus identity, machine-independent). search/filters: restrict to this source.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: ingest: the directory root to walk.

inputs.name: db
inputs.description: the SQLite catalog path (created by ingest/ingest-records/migrate; required to exist for other db-ops).

inputs.name: records
inputs.description: ingest-records: an array of MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 envelope records to land as TYPED records (record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, namespace, text|content_hash, source_version_id?, source_span?, status?, authority_level?, sensitivity_class?, derivation_refs?, parser/chunker/extractor_fingerprint?, token_count?, embedding_space_id?, section_path?, heading?, title?, attrs?, edges[]?).

inputs.name: ingest_run
inputs.description: ingest-records: the ingest-run header {producer, producer_version, namespace, repo_commit, worktree_dirty}.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: search: the LEXICAL backend fts (SQLite FTS5) | exact (literal substring). A4: may also be current_only (a compat shim for the retriever temporal mode -> lexical backend defaults to fts); the canonical temporal mode is filters.mode.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: search: max results.

inputs.name: dim
inputs.description: embedding dimension (mock provider / ingest embed / store-embeddings).

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: L2-normalize embedding vectors.

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: search/list-records: {source, namespace (A4: a HARD boundary -- a single value OR an explicit set/array; enforced before ranking with an all-hits-match assertion), mode (A4 temporal: current_only hard-excludes non-'current'), current_only (bool alias), task_id (A4: working-memory scope -- surfaces a 'working' record only for its own task_id), type (chunk_type), path_prefix (rel_path prefix), content_hash, record_kind, status/currentness, exclude_stale}.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: list-records/export-chunk-texts: max rows (0 = no cap).

inputs.name: max_files
inputs.description: ingest: file budget (0 = no cap); a hit is surfaced as a warning + report.file_budget_hit.

inputs.name: max_chunk_chars
inputs.description: ingest: soft chunk size target (split at blank lines, never inside a code fence). Part of chunker_fingerprint: a change re-derives chunks even when the source hash is unchanged.

inputs.name: embed_provider
inputs.description: ingest: mock (deterministic hashed pseudo-vectors, float32 BLOB) | none (lexical only).

inputs.name: include
inputs.description: ingest: optional include globs on rel_path/filename (default: all text-like).

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: ingest: exclude globs on rel_path/filename (default: *.db etc.).

inputs.name: chunk_ids
inputs.description: store-embeddings: target ids (chunk_id | record_version_id) aligned 1:1 with vectors[].

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.description: store-embeddings: externally-produced vectors (fold drop-in for the real adapter #35); stored as float32 LE BLOB keyed on embedding_space_id.

inputs.name: embedding_space_id
inputs.description: store-embeddings/get-vector: the immutable vector-space id (else derived from provider/model/dim/normalized).

inputs.name: target_kind
inputs.description: store-embeddings/get-vector: chunk | record.

inputs.name: target_id
inputs.description: get-vector: the chunk_id or record_version_id to round-trip. get-record: a single record_version_id to fetch (an rvid is either a typed-record record_version_id or a source_chunk chunk_occurrence_id).

inputs.name: rvids
inputs.description: get-record: the record_version_id(s) to fetch (alias: record_version_ids; or a single record_version_id/target_id). An rvid is a typed-record record_version_id OR a source_chunk chunk_occurrence_id -- the SAME id space search hits + descend leaf_members refer to. Returns per rvid the full s1 envelope + the evidence body for #40 leaf hydration; ns_permitted enforced on every returned record (foreign -> count-only).

inputs.name: current_only
inputs.description: get-record (and a filters.current_only/filters.mode=current_only/exclude_stale alias): VERSION-EXACT by default; when set, EXCLUDE an rvid whose in-scope LIVE successor exists (catalog-computed effective_current, pool-independent) as current_excluded_count.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: build-hierarchy/hierarchy/refresh-hierarchy: the ONE namespace to (re)build/report (omit = all namespaces). shortlist/descend: a single-namespace authorization shim -> the effective set.

inputs.name: max_fanout
inputs.description: build-hierarchy: A6/H4 MAX_FANOUT -- a node holds at most this many children; the balanced even-partition builder keeps depth logarithmic + balance independent of the grouping key.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: descend/hierarchy-regen/prune-verdict: the target node. descend: a foreign/out-of-scope node_id fails closed (count-only).

inputs.name: hierarchy_version
inputs.description: shortlist/descend: pin a specific tree_version; if it is not the current published version it is NOT served (a compile pins one version).

inputs.name: corpus_snapshot
inputs.description: shortlist/descend: the corpus_version the caller pinned; the result flags corpus_snapshot_matches when it diverges from live.

inputs.name: effective_allowed_namespaces
inputs.description: shortlist/descend/get-record: the CALLER-SUPPLIED CLOSED authorized-namespace set (A5/U1'/H6). Enforced (ns_permitted) at every hop + on every returned node/record. Absent = unscoped back-compat; an explicit empty set = zero results. (get-record also honors filters.namespace / a top-level namespace as the effective set.)

inputs.name: retrieval_plan_id
inputs.description: descend: the multi-stage retrieval-plan id carried into the stage lineage (retrieval_stage_id/parent_stage_id).

inputs.name: include_nodes
inputs.description: hierarchy: also return every node's navigation projection (not just the hierarchy meta).

inputs.name: leaf_id
inputs.description: hierarchy-mark-changed: the mutated leaf (record_version_id / chunk_occurrence_id); marks the ancestor path synopses stale + bumps their subtree_generation (H2).

inputs.name: expected_generation
inputs.description: hierarchy-regen: the subtree_generation the caller observed; the freshness clear is CAS'd on it (a stale generation is REFUSED -- the ABA/lost-update guard).

inputs.name: channel
inputs.description: prune-verdict: lexical|entity|path|id (Bloom absence) | kind|authority (exact set) | time (exact range) | descriptor|vector (NEVER prune).

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: prune-verdict: the requirement value tested against the node's synopsis for a SOUND (no-false-negative) absence proof.
